Name: SEASONAL RSV NYAPU PORTRAITS REXTURES BY AHCUTEART
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[b][size=5]SEASONAL RSV NYAPU PORTRAITS – RETEXTURES BY AHCUTEART
[/size][/b]

I adored Nyapu’s portraits and noticed while playing my mega-modded SDV that there were no seasonal portraits. Since Nyapu had no plans to do the seasonal portraits, I decided to retexture the portraits for all the mods I've added to my mega-modded game. After receiving permission from Nyapu for the retextures, and the artists that worked on the original mod, I decided to share mywork with everyone.

[b]IT'S FINALLY DONE!![/b]


[b]INSTALLATION (Must have Smapi):
[/b]
1. ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]
2.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18202] ﻿Seasonal Outfits for Ridgeside Village[/url]
3. ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿
4. ﻿Drag CP folder into your Mods
5. ﻿Optional: Change Ian or Philip appearance in GMCM




- First, Ridgeside Village and all it's requirements need to be installed.

- Second, download the Seasonal Outfits for Ridgeside Village.

- Third, download Generic Mod Config Menu. (Which will allow you to choose different options for you mods).[i]
[/i]
- Lastly, Unzip the CP file and drag it into your Mods folder.

[b]IMPORTANT!: [/b]For those of you who are not installing CP file, I included "Torts Seasonal Outfit Fix" because the original Seasonal Outfits for Ridgeside Village code doesn't work for Torts. So, if you just want the fixed code, unzip it and drag it into your mods folder. A prompt should show up to replace the code. If not this is the file path. [CP] RSV Seasonal Outfits\Data\OutfitChanges\Torts
